text:
Alex: bringing gpt-small-v2 into the eval harness — hitting two things: tokenizer edge-case and a runner crash when using 4-bit quantized weights. anyone seen this pattern before?

Maria: saw the tokenizer mismatch locally. chat templates that include a trailing newline in system messages get tokenized differently than our golden tokenizer. failing metric: exact-match drift on few-shot QA.

Cheng: the runner crash stack is small but weird: `IndexError: token id 50213 out of range` from the batching kernel. repro steps: run `tools/eval_runner --model gpt-small-v2 --quant 4bit --suite chat-bench` on my laptop.

Sam: ack. I think two separate things: 1) tokenizer mapping for the special token ` ` might be off in the model config (weird old bpe variant) and 2) our continuous-batcher assumes vocab_size % 8 == 0 after quantization which isn't always true.

Tori: can you paste the model config and the failing CLI output? I can add a unit test to the harness for both the tokenizer and the batcher. we should also wire this into CI so onboarding fails fast.

Alex: config snippet: ```
model: gpt-small-v2
tokenizer: custom-bpe-v1
vocab_size: 50214
special_tokens:
  - ""
quantization:
  type: awq
  bits: 4
  block_size: 128
```

Alex: failing runner output: ```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"eval_runner.py\", line 412, in <module>
    batcher.prepare(tokens)
  File \"/workspace/eval/harness/batcher.py\", line 211, in prepare
    pad = (8 - (vocab_size % 8)) % 8
IndexError: token id 50213 out of range
```

Maria: that pad math is fine normally but when you quantize to 4-bit we remap ids and the kernel expects padded vocab alignment. if vocab_size isn't padded to 512 multiple the kernel index calc overflows for some blocks.

Cheng: minimal repro patch: in batcher add safe clamp: `idx = min(idx, padded_vocab-1)` and in tokenizer add explicit mapping for `` to last id. but this feels like a bandaid.

Sam: I'd rather fix model config ingestion: if tokenizer declares special tokens that map to >= vocab_size, error out during onboarding with a helpful message. adding a diag check in `onboard_model()` should catch this before it reaches the runtime.

Tori: plan: Sam + Cheng to send two PRs: (A) eval-harness: strict onboarding checks + unit tests for special tokens and vocab padding; (B) runner: defensive indexing + integration test with 4-bit quantized model. I'll add a CI job `onboard-smoke` that runs these checks on PRs with model-metadata changes.

Alex: created a tiny failing test in `tests/test_onboard.py` — will push shortly. also note: chat template mismatch came from the template injector trimming trailing newlines when role==system. that needs a template-level test.

Sam: good catch. add a golden-tokenization fixture that runs tokenizer.encode(template) and compares to stored token sequence. CI should run it for any new chat templates or tokenizer config changes.

eval-bot: CI notice: `eval-harness/onboard-smoke` failed on branch `feature/gpt-small-v2` — error: tokenizer special token index >= vocab_size. See https://ci.redwood.internal/12345 for details.

Maria: linking to the onboard checklist: we should add a step "verify tokenizer special tokens < vocab_size" and "run quantized batcher smoke". also add a monitoring alert that flags sudden exact-match drops after new model rollouts.

Cheng: PRs: https://git.redwood/eval-harness/pull/789 (onboarding checks, tests) and https://git.redwood/eval-harness/pull/790 (runner defensive fix). both include small unit tests and a reproducer script under `tools/repro/gpt-small-v2`.

Alex: thanks team. once PRs merge I'll re-run the full chat-bench and post results. for tracking, adding this thread to the onboarding checklist card #onboard-142. :thumbsup:

Tori: follow-up TODOs: 1) add golden-tokenization CI job, 2) update documentation for quantized vocab padding, 3) ensure dashboard alerts include model-version label. I'll create tasks.

Alex: sounds good. moving to PR review.
